'''Surya''' is a ''[[sul'dam]]'' in the [[Seanchan]] army.

== Activities ==
She is present at the meeting between the [[Dragon Reborn]] and the [[Daughter of the Nine Moons]], when it was revealed that the later was actually [[Semirhage]] in disguise. She moves to protect her ''[[damane]]'' [[Tabi]] when [[Nynaeve al'Meara]] offers to [[Heal]] her group.
